name: FSI Kafka Platform - Alert Conditions
description: NRQL alert conditions for FSI Kafka Platform. Import via NerdGraph alertsNrqlConditionStaticCreate mutation.

conditions.name: MirrorLagCritical - Warning
conditions.description: Mirror lag exceeds warn threshold for critical tier (30s). Monitor for further degradation.

nrql.query: SELECT max(replication.mirrorLagMs) / 1000 AS 'Mirror Lag (seconds)' FROM KafkaClusterLinkSample WHERE sla_tier = 'critical'

conditions.name: ConnectTaskFailed
conditions.description: One or more Kafka Connect connector tasks are in FAILED state. Check Connect logs and restart if appropriate.

nrql.query: SELECT filter(uniqueCount(connectorName), WHERE connector.status = 'FAILED') AS 'Failed Connectors' FROM KafkaConnectSample

conditions.name: ConnectTaskRestartLoop
conditions.description: A Kafka Connect task has restarted 3 or more times in the last 15 minutes. Investigate root cause to prevent repeated failures.

nrql.query: SELECT max(connector.taskRestartCount) FROM KafkaConnectSample FACET connectorName SINCE 15 MINUTES AGO

conditions.name: UnderReplicatedPartitions
conditions.description: Under-replicated partitions detected. This indicates broker health issues or network problems. Investigate immediately.

nrql.query: SELECT latest(broker.underReplicatedPartitions) FROM KafkaBrokerSample WHERE clusterName = '{{CLUSTER_ID}}'
